title: Learn this Worship Dance Combination | Online Liturgical Dance Class

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down choreography count by count with verbal explanations of foot and arm placement. She incorporates ballet and lyrical techniques while demonstrating facing the front.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the video and style
Step by step breakdown of the combination

steps_taught.name: Fondue position with arm stretch and turn
steps_taught.description: One leg bent, one leg straight, arm crosses and turns for two counts then lifts.

what_works: Repetition of the combination without music before adding music

quotes.text: The style is lyrical, which is a combination of ballet, jazz, and modern techniques.
I'm going to be teaching this forward only.
We're going to do a fondue position, which means one leg is bent and one leg is going to be straight.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher speaks to the camera explaining the dance style and that it will be taught facing forward.
Teacher demonstrates foot and arm coordination counting out loud.

extraction.distinctive_method: Emphasizing that the combination is taught 'forward only' for students who requested viewing from the back.
